findings.statement: Canonical equipment cost model = COÛT DE REVIENT journalier/horaire = amortissement journalier + maintenance + carburant + (location éventuelle); the per-hour/day rate is then VALORISÉ when imputed to a chantier (hours/days used × rate).
findings.implication: the engine must compute a per-equipment rate and impute usage to chantiers via hours×rate — feeding chantier-profitability as EQUIPMENT expenses; NOT_MEASURED when the denominator (hours/km) is missing.

findings.statement: Core features: parc availability + affectation, km/heures moteur, contrôles/entretiens/immobilisations, réparations history, stock of matériaux/pièces, maintenance préventive/corrective. Pain points: pertes, pannes, retards, immobilisation.
findings.implication: matches directive §2–§7 scope; the differentiator stays the chantier-cost integration (§8) without double-counting purchase vs consumption.

findings.statement: Attach equipment usage + stock CONSUMPTION (not purchase/reception) to chantiers so margin reflects real imputed cost; a stock entry must never auto-become a chantier charge.
findings.implication: feeds the anti-double-count imputation rule in parc-stock-engine + V149 dossier.
